title: Recognise general counsel, in-house lawyers as legal practitioners: GCAI urges BCI
description: The General Counsels’ Association of India (GCAI) has urged the Bar Council of India (BCI) to recognise general counsel and in-house lawyers working in private, public and joint-sector organisations as “legal practitioners”.In a representation concerning the Draft Advocates (Amendment) Bill, 2026, the Association also sought changes to Rule 49 of the Bar Council of India Rules so that advocates do not lose their professional status merely because they take up full-time salaried employment."GCAI
